mapper.select: select version_code versionCode, display_name displayName, resource_path resourcePath, status, published_at publishedAt from kg_ontology_version where version_code = #{versionCode} and status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into kg_entity (entity_type, external_key, canonical_name, normalized_name, properties_json, review_status, ontology_version, create_time, update_time) values (#{entityType}, #{externalKey}, #{canonicalName}, #{normalizedName}, #{propertiesJson}, #{reviewStatus}, #{ontologyVersion}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update canonical_name = values(canonical_name), normalized_name = values(normalized_name), properties_json = values(properties_json), review_status = case when review_status = 'ACCEPTED' then 'ACCEPTED' else values(review_status) end, ontology_version = values(ontology_version), update_time = sysdate()

insert into kg_entity_alias (entity_id, alias_name, normalized_alias, source_type, source_ref, create_time) values (#{entityId}, #{aliasName}, #{normalizedAlias}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRef}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update alias_name = values(alias_name), source_type = values(source_type), source_ref = values(source_ref)

insert into kg_relation (source_entity_id, relation_type, target_entity_id, confidence, valid_from, valid_to, review_status, ontology_version, source_kind, properties_json, create_time, update_time) values (#{sourceEntityId}, #{relationType}, #{targetEntityId}, #{confidence}, sysdate(), null, #{reviewStatus}, #{ontologyVersion}, #{sourceKind}, #{propertiesJson}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update confidence = values(confidence), valid_to = null, review_status = case when review_status = 'ACCEPTED' then 'ACCEPTED' else values(review_status) end, ontology_version = values(ontology_version), source_kind = values(source_kind), properties_json = values(properties_json), update_time = sysdate()
mapper.update: update kg_relation set valid_to = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where source_entity_id = #{sourceEntityId} and source_kind in ('PROFILE_PROJECTION', 'CERTIFICATION_PROJECTION') and relation_type in ( 'BELONGS_TO', 'HAS_CREDENTIAL', 'EXPERTISE_IN', 'WORKS_IN_INDUSTRY', 'SERVES_REGION', 'HAS_CERTIFICATION' ) and (valid_to is null or valid_to > sysdate())

update kg_relation set valid_to = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where target_entity_id = #{expertEntityId} and relation_type = 'HAS_EXPERT' and source_kind = 'PROFILE_PROJECTION' and (valid_to is null or valid_to > sysdate())
mapper.insert: insert into kg_evidence (evidence_key, relation_id, entity_id, source_type, source_ref, material_id, page_no, char_start, char_end, quote_hash, excerpt, confidence, review_status, extractor_version, create_time) values (#{evidenceKey}, #{relationId}, #{entityId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRef}, #{materialId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{pageNo,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{charStart,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{charEnd,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{quoteHash}, #{excerpt}, #{confidence}, 'PENDING', #{extractorVersion}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update relation_id = values(relation_id), entity_id = values(entity_id), source_type = values(source_type), source_ref = values(source_ref), material_id = values(material_id), page_no = values(page_no), char_start = values(char_start), char_end = values(char_end), quote_hash = values(quote_hash), excerpt = values(excerpt), confidence = values(confidence), review_status = 'PENDING', reviewed_excerpt = null, reviewed_source_name = null, reviewed_source_type = null, reviewed_relation_type = null, reviewed_target_name = null, reviewed_target_type = null, review_comment = null, reviewer_name = null, review_time = null, extractor_version = values(extractor_version)
mapper.update: update kg_relation r join ( select distinct relation_id from kg_evidence where material_id = #{materialId} ) material_relations on material_relations.relation_id = r.relation_id left join ( select ev.relation_id, count(1) supporting_evidence_count from kg_evidence ev join expert_material em on em.material_id = ev.material_id where em.review_status = 'APPROVED' and em.material_id = ( select max(active_m.material_id) from expert_material active_m where active_m.user_id = em.user_id and active_m.material_category = em.material_category and active_m.review_status = 'APPROVED' ) group by ev.relation_id ) active_support on active_support.relation_id = r.relation_id set r.review_status = case when #{reviewStatus} = 'ACCEPTED' and r.review_status = 'REJECTED' then 'REJECTED' when #{reviewStatus} = 'ACCEPTED' then 'ACCEPTED' when coalesce(active_support.supporting_evidence_count, 0) > 0 then 'ACCEPTED' else 'REJECTED' end, r.valid_to = case when #{reviewStatus} = 'ACCEPTED' then r.valid_to when #{reviewStatus} = 'REJECTED' and coalesce(active_support.supporting_evidence_count, 0) = 0 then coalesce(r.valid_to, sysdate()) else r.valid_to end, r.update_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: select r.relation_id relationId, coalesce(max(ev.reviewed_relation_type), r.relation_type) relationType, r.relation_type originalRelationType, max(ev.reviewed_relation_type) reviewedRelationType, coalesce(max(ev.reviewed_source_name), se.canonical_name) sourceName, se.canonical_name originalSourceName, max(ev.reviewed_source_name) reviewedSourceName, coalesce(max(ev.reviewed_source_type), se.entity_type) sourceType, se.entity_type originalSourceType, max(ev.reviewed_source_type) reviewedSourceType, coalesce(max(ev.reviewed_target_name), te.canonical_name) targetName, te.canonical_name originalTargetName, max(ev.reviewed_target_name) reviewedTargetName, coalesce(max(ev.reviewed_target_type), te.entity_type) targetType, te.entity_type originalTargetType, max(ev.reviewed_target_type) reviewedTargetType, case when sum(case when ev.review_status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 'PENDING' when sum(case when ev.review_status = 'REJECTED' then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 'REJECTED' else 'ACCEPTED' end reviewStatus, r.confidence relationConfidence, coalesce(max(ev.reviewed_excerpt), max(ev.excerpt)) excerpt, max(ev.excerpt) originalExcerpt, max(ev.reviewed_excerpt) reviewedExcerpt, max(ev.review_comment) reviewComment, max(ev.confidence) evidenceConfidence, count(1) evidenceCount from kg_relation r join kg_evidence ev on ev.relation_id = r.relation_id join kg_entity se on se.entity_id = r.source_entity_id join kg_entity te on te.entity_id = r.target_entity_id where ev.material_id = #{materialId} group by r.relation_id, r.relation_type, se.canonical_name, se.entity_type, te.canonical_name, te.entity_type, r.confidence order by r.relation_id
mapper.update: update kg_evidence set reviewed_excerpt = #{reviewedExcerpt}, reviewed_source_name = #{reviewedSourceName}, reviewed_source_type = #{reviewedSourceType}, reviewed_relation_type = #{reviewedRelationType}, reviewed_target_name = #{reviewedTargetName}, reviewed_target_type = #{reviewedTargetType}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, reviewer_name = #{reviewerName}, review_time = sysdate() where material_id = #{materialId} and relation_id = #{relationId} and review_status = 'PENDING'

update kg_entity e join kg_relation r on r.source_entity_id = e.entity_id join ( select max(reviewed_source_name) reviewed_name, max(reviewed_source_type) reviewed_type from kg_evidence where material_id = #{materialId} and relation_id = #{relationId} ) reviewed on reviewed.reviewed_name is not null set e.canonical_name = reviewed.reviewed_name, e.entity_type = coalesce(reviewed.reviewed_type, e.entity_type), e.normalized_name = lower(trim(reviewed.reviewed_name)), e.update_time = sysdate() where r.relation_id = #{relationId}

update kg_entity e join kg_relation r on r.target_entity_id = e.entity_id join ( select max(reviewed_target_name) reviewed_name, max(reviewed_target_type) reviewed_type from kg_evidence where material_id = #{materialId} and relation_id = #{relationId} ) reviewed on reviewed.reviewed_name is not null set e.canonical_name = reviewed.reviewed_name, e.entity_type = coalesce(reviewed.reviewed_type, e.entity_type), e.normalized_name = lower(trim(reviewed.reviewed_name)), e.update_time = sysdate() where r.relation_id = #{relationId}

update kg_entity e join kg_relation r on r.source_entity_id = e.entity_id and r.review_status = 'ACCEPTED' join ( select relation_id, max(reviewed_source_name) reviewed_name, max(reviewed_source_type) reviewed_type from kg_evidence where material_id = #{materialId} and reviewed_source_name is not null group by relation_id ) reviewed on reviewed.relation_id = r.relation_id set e.canonical_name = reviewed.reviewed_name, e.entity_type = coalesce(reviewed.reviewed_type, e.entity_type), e.normalized_name = lower(trim(reviewed.reviewed_name)), e.update_time = sysdate()

update kg_entity e join kg_relation r on r.target_entity_id = e.entity_id and r.review_status = 'ACCEPTED' join ( select relation_id, max(reviewed_target_name) reviewed_name, max(reviewed_target_type) reviewed_type from kg_evidence where material_id = #{materialId} and reviewed_target_name is not null group by relation_id ) reviewed on reviewed.relation_id = r.relation_id set e.canonical_name = reviewed.reviewed_name, e.entity_type = coalesce(reviewed.reviewed_type, e.entity_type), e.normalized_name = lower(trim(reviewed.reviewed_name)), e.update_time = sysdate()

update kg_relation r join ( select relation_id, max(reviewed_relation_type) reviewed_type from kg_evidence where material_id = #{materialId} and reviewed_relation_type is not null group by relation_id ) reviewed on reviewed.relation_id = r.relation_id set r.relation_type = reviewed.reviewed_type, r.update_time = sysdate() where r.review_status = 'ACCEPTED'

update kg_relation set review_status = #{reviewStatus}, valid_to = case when #{reviewStatus} = 'REJECTED' then coalesce(valid_to, sysdate()) when #{reviewStatus} = 'ACCEPTED' then null else valid_to end, update_time = sysdate() where relation_id = #{relationId}

update kg_entity e join ( select distinct entity_id from kg_evidence where material_id = #{materialId} and entity_id is not null ) material_entities on material_entities.entity_id = e.entity_id set e.review_status = 'ACCEPTED', e.update_time = sysdate()
mapper.delete: delete r from kg_relation r join ( select distinct e.relation_id from kg_evidence e join expert_material m on m.material_id = e.material_id where m.user_id = #{userId} ) material_relations on material_relations.relation_id = r.relation_id
delete e from kg_evidence e join expert_material m on m.material_id = e.material_id where m.user_id = #{userId}

delete r from kg_relation r join ( select distinct relation_id from kg_evidence where material_id = #{materialId} and relation_id is not null ) material_relations on material_relations.relation_id = r.relation_id where r.source_kind in ('LLM', 'RULE')
delete from kg_relation where source_kind in ('LLM', 'RULE') and not exists ( select 1 from kg_evidence ev where ev.relation_id = kg_relation.relation_id )
mapper.insert: insert into kg_change_outbox (event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload_json, event_status, attempt_count, available_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{payloadJson}, 'PENDING', 0, sysdate(), sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: select event_id eventId, event_type eventType, aggregate_type aggregateType, aggregate_id aggregateId, payload_json payloadJson, attempt_count attemptCount, create_time createTime from kg_change_outbox where event_status = 'PENDING' and available_at <= sysdate() order by create_time limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update kg_change_outbox set event_status = 'PROCESSING', locked_at = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where event_id = #{eventId} and event_status = 'PENDING'
update kg_change_outbox set event_status = 'DONE', last_error = null, update_time = sysdate() where event_id = #{eventId}

update kg_change_outbox set event_status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, available_at = date_add(sysdate(), interval least(attempt_count + 1, 60) minute), locked_at = null, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = sysdate() where event_id = #{eventId}

update kg_change_outbox set event_status = 'PENDING', locked_at = null, available_at = sysdate(), last_error = '处理超时，已重新排队', update_time = sysdate() where event_status = 'PROCESSING' and locked_at < date_sub(sysdate(), interval 10 minute)
mapper.select: select entity_id entityId, entity_type entityType, external_key externalKey, canonical_name canonicalName, normalized_name normalizedName, properties_json propertiesJson, review_status reviewStatus, ontology_version ontologyVersion, create_time createTime, update_time updateTime from kg_entity where entity_type = 'Expert' and external_key = concat('expert:', #{userId})

select entity_id entityId, entity_type entityType, external_key externalKey, canonical_name canonicalName, normalized_name normalizedName, properties_json propertiesJson, review_status reviewStatus, ontology_version ontologyVersion, create_time createTime, update_time updateTime from kg_entity where entity_id = #{entityId}
select entity_id from kg_entity where entity_type = 'Task' order by entity_id
mapper.delete: delete from kg_entity where entity_type = 'Expert' and external_key = concat('expert:', #{userId})
mapper.select: select e.entity_id entityId, e.entity_type entityType, e.external_key externalKey, e.canonical_name canonicalName, e.normalized_name normalizedName, e.properties_json propertiesJson, e.review_status reviewStatus, e.ontology_version ontologyVersion, e.create_time createTime, e.update_time updateTime, ( select count(1) from kg_evidence ev where ev.entity_id = e.entity_id ) evidenceCount from kg_entity e where e.review_status = 'ACCEPTED' and e.entity_type in ( 'Industry', 'Expert', 'Project', 'Achievement', 'Technology', 'Capability', 'ServiceRegion', 'Organization', 'Credential' ) and exists ( select 1 from kg_relation current_relation join kg_evidence current_ev on current_ev.relation_id = current_relation.relation_id left join expert_material current_m on current_m.material_id = current_ev.material_id where ( current_relation.source_entity_id = e.entity_id or current_relation.target_entity_id = e.entity_id ) and current_relation.review_status = 'ACCEPTED' and (current_relation.valid_to is null or current_relation.valid_to > sysdate()) and ( current_ev.material_id is null or ( current_m.review_status = 'APPROVED' and current_m.material_id = ( select max(latest_m.material_id) from expert_material latest_m where latest_m.user_id = current_m.user_id and latest_m.material_category = current_m.material_category and latest_m.review_status = 'APPROVED' ) ) ) ) order by case e.entity_type when 'Industry' then 0 when 'Expert' then 1 when 'Project' then 2 when 'Achievement' then 3 when 'Technology' then 4 when 'Capability' then 5 when 'ServiceRegion' then 6 when 'Organization' then 7 when 'Credential' then 8 else 9 end, e.canonical_name limit #{limit}

select r.relation_id relationId, r.relation_type relationType, r.source_entity_id sourceEntityId, se.entity_type sourceEntityType, se.canonical_name sourceEntityName, r.target_entity_id targetEntityId, te.entity_type targetEntityType, te.canonical_name targetEntityName, r.confidence, r.valid_from validFrom, r.valid_to validTo, r.review_status reviewStatus, r.ontology_version ontologyVersion, r.source_kind sourceKind, r.properties_json propertiesJson, ( select count(1) from kg_evidence ev where ev.relation_id = r.relation_id ) evidenceCount from kg_relation r join kg_entity se on se.entity_id = r.source_entity_id join kg_entity te on te.entity_id = r.target_entity_id where r.review_status = 'ACCEPTED' and (r.valid_to is null or r.valid_to > sysdate()) and se.review_status = 'ACCEPTED' and te.review_status = 'ACCEPTED' and se.entity_type <> 'Task' and te.entity_type <> 'Task' and exists ( select 1 from kg_evidence current_ev left join expert_material current_m on current_m.material_id = current_ev.material_id where current_ev.relation_id = r.relation_id and ( current_ev.material_id is null or ( current_m.review_status = 'APPROVED' and current_m.material_id = ( select max(latest_m.material_id) from expert_material latest_m where latest_m.user_id = current_m.user_id and latest_m.material_category = current_m.material_category and latest_m.review_status = 'APPROVED' ) ) ) ) order by case r.relation_type when 'HAS_EXPERT' then 0 when 'PARTICIPATED_IN' then 1 when 'PRODUCED' then 2 else 3 end, r.relation_id limit #{limit}

select distinct e.entity_id entityId, e.entity_type entityType, e.external_key externalKey, e.canonical_name canonicalName, e.normalized_name normalizedName, e.properties_json propertiesJson, e.review_status reviewStatus, e.ontology_version ontologyVersion, e.create_time createTime, e.update_time updateTime from kg_entity e join kg_evidence ev on ev.entity_id = e.entity_id join expert_material m on m.material_id = ev.material_id where m.user_id = #{userId} and m.review_status = 'APPROVED' and m.material_id = ( select max(m2.material_id) from expert_material m2 where m2.user_id = m.user_id and m2.material_category = m.material_category and m2.review_status = 'APPROVED' ) and e.review_status <> 'REJECTED' order by e.entity_id
